# Particles tools

5 tools. Not registered under `GODOT_MCP_PROFILE=core`; ask for it by name with `GODOT_MCP_CATEGORIES=particles`.

[← All categories](README.md)

## `create_particle_system`

Add a GPUParticles3D or GPUParticles2D node to the scene. Creates an empty particle system — use set_particle_material or load_particle_preset to configure it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `parent_path` | `string` | — | Path to the parent node. Omit or use '.' for scene root. |
| `node_name` | `string` | — | Name for the new node (default: 'GPUParticles3D' or 'GPUParticles2D') |
| `dimension` | `string` | — | Whether to create a 3D or 2D particle system (default: '3d') One of: `"3d"`, `"2d"`. |
| `amount` | `integer` | — | Maximum number of particles alive at once (default: 100) |
| `lifetime` | `number` | — | Particle lifetime in seconds (default: 1.0) |
| `emitting` | `boolean` | — | Start emitting particles immediately (default: true) |
| `one_shot` | `boolean` | — | Emit all particles once and stop, rather than looping (default: false) |
| `position` | `object`, `string`, `array` | — | Local position of the particle node Array items are `number`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/12-particles.json`, test PT-01:

```json
{
  "parent_path": ".",
  "node_name": "Particles",
  "dimension": "2d",
  "amount": 50
}
```

## `set_particle_material`

Create or update the ParticleProcessMaterial on a GPUParticles node. Controls particle physics: direction, velocity, gravity, scale, color, and emission shape.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the GPUParticles3D or GPUParticles2D node |
| `direction` | `object`, `string`, `array` | — | Emission direction vector (default: {x:0, y:1, z:0}) Array items are `number`. |
| `spread` | `number` | — | Cone spread angle in degrees around direction (default: 45.0, 0 = straight line, 180 = full hemisphere) |
| `gravity` | `object`, `string`, `array` | — | Gravity applied to particles (default: {x:0, y:-9.8, z:0}) Array items are `number`. |
| `initial_velocity_min` | `number` | — | Minimum initial particle speed (default: 1.0) |
| `initial_velocity_max` | `number` | — | Maximum initial particle speed (default: 1.0) |
| `angular_velocity_min` | `number` | — | Minimum rotation speed in degrees/second |
| `angular_velocity_max` | `number` | — | Maximum rotation speed in degrees/second |
| `scale_min` | `number` | — | Minimum particle scale (default: 1.0) |
| `scale_max` | `number` | — | Maximum particle scale (default: 1.0) |
| `damping_min` | `number` | — | Minimum velocity damping applied over lifetime |
| `damping_max` | `number` | — | Maximum velocity damping applied over lifetime |
| `color` | `string` | — | Base particle color as HTML hex string, e.g. '#ff8800' (default: white) |
| `emission_shape` | `string` | — | Emission volume shape (default: 'point') One of: `"point"`, `"sphere"`, `"sphere_surface"`, `"box"`, `"ring"`. |
| `emission_sphere_radius` | `number` | — | Radius of sphere/sphere_surface emission shape |
| `emission_box_extents` | `object`, `string`, `array` | — | Half-extents of the box emission volume Array items are `number`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/12-particles.json`, test PT-03:

```json
{
  "node_path": "Particles",
  "spread": 30
}
```

## `set_particle_gradient`

Assign a color gradient to a particle system's material. The gradient controls color or initial color over each particle's lifetime. Requires the node to already have a ParticleProcessMaterial (call set_particle_material first).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the GPUParticles3D or GPUParticles2D node |
| `colors` | `array` | yes | Array of color stops defining the gradient. Each entry: {"offset": 0.0–1.0, "color": "#rrggbb"}. Must have at least 2 entries. Array items are `object`. |
| `gradient_type` | `string` | — | 'color_ramp' (default) — color varies over particle lifetime. 'color_initial_ramp' — color varies by emission angle. One of: `"color_ramp"`, `"color_initial_ramp"`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/12-particles.json`, test PT-04:

```json
{
  "node_path": "Particles",
  "colors": [
    {
      "offset": 0,
      "color": "#ff0000"
    },
    {
      "offset": 1,
      "color": "#0000ff"
    }
  ]
}
```

## `load_particle_preset`

Apply a built-in particle effect preset to a GPUParticles node. Replaces the current process material, amount, and lifetime with preset values. Fully undoable.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the GPUParticles3D or GPUParticles2D node |
| `preset` | `string` | yes | Preset to apply. 'explosion' also enables one_shot mode. Each preset configures direction, spread, gravity, velocity, scale, and color. One of: `"fire"`, `"smoke"`, `"sparks"`, `"rain"`, `"snow"`, `"explosion"`, `"magic"`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/12-particles.json`, test PT-05:

```json
{
  "node_path": "Particles",
  "preset": "fire"
}
```

## `get_particle_info`

Get the current configuration of a GPUParticles node: amount, lifetime, emit state, and ParticleProcessMaterial properties (direction, velocity, color, emission shape, gradient presence).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the GPUParticles3D or GPUParticles2D node |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/12-particles.json`, test PT-02:

```json
{
  "node_path": "Particles"
}
```
